translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Roma
book.title: Surat ni Paulus Bona Jama'at Na Kota ROMA

content: Potoo ni Paulus
Yaku' moki piile' na ko'omuu utusta wiwine men i Febe. Utusta iya'a papalimangna jama'at na Kengkrea.
Labot i ia koi sa'angu' mianna Tumpu. Mian men parasaya na Alaata'ala tiodaa poolaboti tia simbaya'na. Kalu ia moki tulung, uga' tulung i ia, gause i ia nuntulungmo mian biai', tonsoop tii yaku'.
Salamku ni Priskila tii Akwila. Raaya'a simbaya'ku men balimang ni Kristus Yesus.

Raaya'a toro-toro lapus gause nansalangi i yaku'. Yaku' basukuur na ko'ona i raaya'a, ka' taasi' tongko' i yaku', kasee giigii' jama'atna mian na lipu' sambana men taasi' Yahudi uga' basukuur na ko'ona i raaya'a.
Salamku na jama'at men barimpung na laiganna i raaya'a. Salamku ni Epenetus, utusku sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men kolingu'ku. Iamo a mian na poropinsi Asia men tumbena noparasaya ni Kristus.
Salamku uga' ni Maria. Ia nobalimangmo men kakat bo ko'omuu.

Salamku ni Andronikus tii Yunias. Raaya'a sa'angu' lipu' tii yaku' ka' isianmo ninsoop na tarungkuan singka-singkat tii yaku'. Sianpo tia i yaku' noparasaya ni Kristus, raaya'a noko olukonmo parasaya. Raaya'a uga' tonsoop poposuu' men tongaan.
Salamku ni Ampliatus, men kolingu'ku tia polingu' men ringkat na Tumpu.
Salamku ni Urbanus, simbaya'ta men balimang ni Kristus. Ka' salamku ni Stakhis men kolingu'ku.
Salamku ni Apeles. Palolo'anna ni Yesus Kristus manasamo. Salamku uga' ni Aristobulus sangkau laigan,
ka' ni Herodion men sa'angu' lipu' tii yaku'. Salamku uga' bona utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an na suo' ni Narkisus sangkau laigan.
Salamku ni Trifena tii Trifosa men kakat balimang bona Tumpu, ka' ni Persis men kolingu'ku. Ia uga' nokakatmo balimang bona Tumpu.
Salamku ni Rufus moto sina, men surionku se' sinana iya'a uga' koimo sinangku. Rufus a mian men ia rurukimo Tumpu.
Salamku ni Asinkritus, ni Flegon, ni Hermes, ni Patrobas, ni Hermas ka' bona giigii' utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men ruru-ruru' tii raaya'a.
Salamku ni Filologus tii Yulia, ni Nereus tia utusna men wiwine, ni Olimpas ka' bona giigii' mian parasaya men ruru-ruru' tii raaya'a.
Poosalami ka' poo'ooki tia noa men molinas i kuu men sa'angu' kaparasaya'an. Giigii' jama'at ni Kristus moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu.
Ururan kokomburi'anna

Utu-utus! Pa'ase'onku tuu', maka'amat na mian men tongko' mantakakon poosasala'an ka' mingiliaskon kaparasaya'anna mianna Tumpu. Men koiya'a pootetengkea'i tia upa men nipisiso'konmo na ko'omuu. Alia mangkarani' mian men koiya'a.

Gause mian men koiya'a wawauna, taasi' balimang na Tumpunta i Kristus, kasee tongko' mongoloingikon pingkira'na noana i raaya'a. Raaya'a mangande-ande wurungna, ka' mambaetok mian men sian poo'inti'i upa-upa.
Giigii' mian ninginti'imo se' kuu malolo' na Lele Pore, ka' yaku' beleskon tuu' i kuu, kasee kikira'ku kada' i kuu minginti'i upa men daa pore, ka' alia mingimamat upa men ba'idek.
Alaata'ala men mantarai koratongan na mian, sabole donganmo minsidakon Ibiliis sianmo momoko ba'upa na ko'omuu. Sulano kaporean ni Yesus Tumpunta surionmuu na tutuo'muu!
Timotius men simbaya'ku balimang moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu. Lukius, Yason ka' i Sosipater, men sa'angu' lipu' tii yaku', moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu.
Men nuntulis surat kani'i mase yaku' i Tertius. Salamku bo ko'omuu men parasaya na Tumpu.

Gayus men nintundaanku a laiganna, ka' men barimpunganna jama'atmai uga' moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu. Erastus men panganaa' doi'na pamarentana kota moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu. Ka' uga' i Kwartus, utusta sa'angu' kaparasaya'an, moki tundunkon salamna bo ko'omuu. [
Sulano kaporeanna Tumpunta i Yesus Kristus surionmuu na tutuo'muu. Amin.]
Pangkakabusi surat

Tontunde' a Alaata'ala! Ia kuasaan mamakadodor imaanmuu sintutu' tia Lele Pore men yaku' lelekon muntundun i Yesus Kristus. Loloonanmo taun a Lele Pore iya'a sianpo ia inti'i mian koi men ia popo'inti'ikon Alaata'ala.

Kasee koini'i, gause ia posuu' Alaata'ala men sidutu, mbaka' Lele Pore iya'a nipopo'inti'ikonmo ka' nilelekon na giigii' lipu' koi men ia poko tulismo nabii, kada' giigii' lipu' parasaya ka' malolo' na Alaata'ala.
Iamo a Alaata'ala men sa'a-sa'angu', men balaki' a pinginti'ian-Na! Sulano i kita mangangga'i Alaata'ala pataka sidutu mimpu'u ni Yesus Kristus! Amin.
